name: NYU Libraries: Presidential executive orders (Trans-Media microfilm, Film 709) and HeinOnline Presidential Executive Orders
description: Film 709: 11 reels of 35 mm microfilm, offsite in two boxes, both listed as available (verified by the owner's browser agent, 2026-11-06). HeinOnline: 11 digitized volumes covering 1845-1936; a browser agent opened the scanned image of EO 708.
secondary_unit_note: Assumed equal to the reel number (11 reels, 11 volumes). Unverified: confirm with EO 707/708 and 1348/1349 in Hein before relying on it.
date_coverage_source: HeinOnline's stated range; the numbered reels end at EO 7403 (June 1936)
restrictions: Owner 2026-10-19 (HANDOFF/notes-claude.md): no paid reproduction and no hand-scanning of microfilm; do not plan around the reel set. Requesting or scanning Film 709 reels needs the owner's explicit go-ahead (Kean A-20261106-dagron-nyu).

Do not scrape or bulk-download HeinOnline through an automated job (HANDOFF/astra-history-through-20261029.md). Retrieve item by item at a human pace, within NYU's HeinOnline licence; stop on any systematic-download warning.

Do not run a bulk harvest through the owner's NYU session without NYU's written approval (HANDOFF/notes-claude.md, 2026-10-19); the NYU bulk-access request was not sent (research/readiness/owner_rulings/2026-10-21-proquest-request.md).

A microfilm or HeinOnline image is graded nyu_collection_image_pending_codebook: acceptable_as_original false, needs_page_check true. It never counts as the original without a page check and a codebook grade, and it must not be placed in research/stage21/original_sources/ (the tracker counts PDF_BYTES_CAPTURED custody rows there).
